fields.why: Average annual rates and 2011–2015 APCs are reported for three age groups (10–14, 15–19, 20–24) and compared.
Sex has 2 levels; race/ethnicity appears only in a limitation; mechanism and disposition are not SPDs.

The 'significantly higher' claim sets 20–24 against each of 10–14 and 15–19 (per-group vs referent). The APCs by age are each tested only against zero (rule 6) and then listed side by side with no test of their difference.
